units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 59a:3">Snh. 59ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 33:4">Deut. XXXIII, 4</cite>) <he>לנו מ׳ ולא להם</he> it is our inheritance, not theirs.
Ib. מאן דאמר מ׳ מיגזל וכ׳ according to him who reads morashah, he (the gentile studying the Law) robs (us).
Ber. 57ᵃ, a. e. אל תקרי מ׳ אלא מְאוֹרָשָׂה read not (Deut. l. c.) morashah inheritance, but m’orasah (betrothed), v. אָרַס.
